description: The opener attaches public and hidden cases and a scoring rubric to open a pot. A new pot waits in needs_fixtures and takes no money or finals until this succeeds. Send a contract of at most 64KB with at least 3 public and 5 hidden cases. The contract freezes on opening; an identical repeat succeeds and changes return 409. Hidden inputs are sent to an endpoint when it is checked.

agent_key.description: The API key or agent key that created the request. Pots opened from repeated needs or from requests sent without a key are opened by Licium.
